construction.label: 01 — Construction
construction.title: Building with foundation, method and on-site presence.

moradiaUni.title: Single-family Houses
moradiaUni.desc: Complete construction of individual houses from foundations to handover.

moradiaMulti.title: Multi-family Houses
moradiaMulti.desc: Buildings with multiple housing units, with structural rigour and finishing.

muros.title: Walls and Outdoor Structures
muros.desc: Retaining, fence and containment walls, adapted to the site conditions.

aterros.title: Embankments
aterros.desc: Moving and compacting soil to prepare platforms and slopes.

terraplanagem.title: Earthworks
terraplanagem.desc: Levelling and shaping the ground for construction or other uses.

preparacaoTerreno.title: Site Preparation
preparacaoTerreno.desc: Clearing, access, drainage and organisation of the space before structural work.

solo.label: Ground
solo.title: The site as foundation.
solo.description: Construction begins before the first wall. Reading the site, geological analysis and assessing access determine how the work is prepared.

preparation.label: Preparation
preparation.title: Before the visible structure.
preparation.description: Embankments, earthworks, levelling and organisation of the space create the technical platform on which everything else sits.

structure.label: Structure
structure.title: Concrete and masonry.
structure.description: Reinforced concrete structure, load-bearing walls and supporting elements define the permanent geometry of the building.

finishes.label: Finishes
finishes.title: Detail and final quality.
finishes.description: Coatings, joinery, installations and general finishes complete the work and define its final character.

delivery.label: Handover
delivery.title: From site to asset.
delivery.description: The finished work is handed over with all documentation, licensing and conditions for habitation or use.

engineering.label: 02 — Engineering
engineering.title: Engineering to turn intent into execution.

reading.title: Reading the site
reading.desc: Analysis of physical, topographic and geological conditions before any intervention.

planning.title: Technical planning
planning.desc: Defining phases, resources and a logical execution sequence for each project.

coordination.title: Site coordination
coordination.desc: Technical follow-up of the work fronts, ensuring alignment with the project.

support.title: Execution support
support.desc: Technical response to unexpected events and decisions based on site knowledge.

phases.title: Phase organisation
phases.desc: Sequencing of the project stages to optimise time, cost and quality.

decisions.title: Decisions with a technical basis
decisions.desc: Every site decision is backed by technical analysis, not just intuition.

read.label: Read
read.title: Observe and understand.
read.description: Read the site, the constraints and the real context before any decision. Technical reading is the first step of any solid project.

plan.label: Plan
plan.title: Structure the technical path.
plan.description: Define phases, resources, sequence and control points along the project. Planning anticipates decisions and reduces unexpected events.

coordinate.label: Coordinate
coordinate.title: Align the people involved.
coordinate.description: Ensure consistency between project and execution, follow progress and connect the different work fronts.

follow.label: Follow up
follow.title: Be present in critical phases.
follow.description: Respond technically to unexpected events and ensure quality of execution in the decisive phases of the project.

process.subtitle: A visual walk-through of the path that turns site, technical decision, construction and property into a complete value cycle.

terreno.subtitle: The starting point
terreno.title: Site
terreno.description: It all starts with the place: access, topography, surroundings and potential. Every piece of land has its own reading.
terreno.detail: Analysis of access, solar orientation, levels and surroundings. The land says more than it seems.

leituraTecnica.subtitle: Applied engineering
leituraTecnica.title: Technical Reading
leituraTecnica.description: Engineering turns real conditions into execution decisions. Every technical detail prevents future mistakes.
leituraTecnica.detail: Phase planning, identification of constraints, definition of access and structure.

preparacao.subtitle: The base before the base
preparacao.title: Preparation
preparacao.description: Embankments, earthworks, access and organisation of the space create the real base of the project.
preparacao.detail: Earth moving, levelling, drainage and structural site preparation.

construcao.subtitle: Execution with method
construcao.title: Construction
construcao.description: Matter takes shape through coordinated execution, phase by phase, with technical rigour.
construcao.detail: Structure, masonry, roof, finishes — each stage delivered with precision.

propriedade.subtitle: From site to asset
propriedade.title: Property
propriedade.description: The construction becomes an asset: a home, a house, an opportunity with real value.
propriedade.detail: Documentation, preparation for habitability, handover and post-construction follow-up.

mercado.subtitle: Value in motion
mercado.title: Market
mercado.description: The real estate side brings the project closer to those looking to buy, sell or develop.
mercado.detail: Market positioning, asset valuation, sales support.

contact.subtitle: A piece of land, a project, a property — whatever the starting point, the first step is a conversation.
